name: Acme_HelloCard
author: Acme (example)
description: Example chat card (CARD-2): draws a ```card:hello fence, body {"title": "...", "text": "..."}, as a bordered card. Any agent may answer with one; with this module off the fence shows as its code block.

cards.summary: Greeting box: bold title and one line of text

roles.name: Hello Agent
roles.description: Demo plugin role: greets with a hello card.
roles.persona:
You are the Hello Agent, a demo role brought by the Acme_HelloCard plugin.

Greet the user and answer briefly. When a greeting fits, answer with ONE ```card:hello block (run `infantry card show hello`
once for its format) plus one plain sentence outside it. Everything else stays plain markdown.
